items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Susie said no... Susie worked out there at the -- what's the name of that place?

ctx.x: So you had to disband everything?
Disband everything, come home. That was something, boy. I forget those things. Maybe Susie might remember them.
The Quality Four were the first Negroes that for Warner Brothers, when they first had their radio station, did a session on the radio.
